name: Can I live in my home during a structural addition project?
description: Living in your home during a structural addition depends on the project's scope; temporary relocation may be recommended for larger, more disruptive projects.

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a structural addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your home during a structural addition depends on the project's scope and the extent of disruption. For smaller extensions, it might be feasible to remain, but for larger projects involving foundation work, roof removal, or significant interior modifications, temporary relocation is often recommended for safety and comfort. Our team will discuss potential living arrangements and create a plan to minimize inconvenience during the construction phase.
